description: This file implements a command line interface for libnvram, providing commands such as show, info, get, set, unset, and commit to interact with NVRAM data. It includes functions for opening, reading, and modifying NVRAM, and a main function that parses command line arguments to execute these commands.

methods.name: nvram_open_rdonly
methods.description: Opens NVRAM in read-only mode, trying staging or MTD files.

methods.name: nvram_open_staging
methods.description: Opens staging NVRAM for read-write access.

methods.name: do_show
methods.description: Prints all key-value pairs stored in NVRAM.

methods.name: do_get
methods.description: Retrieves and prints the value of a specified variable from NVRAM.

methods.name: do_set
methods.description: Sets a variable in NVRAM with a specified value.

methods.name: do_info
methods.description: Displays header and usage info of NVRAM.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the CLI.
